name: Release graph receipt audit simulation
target: Replay four historical release gate runs through receipt audit, residual retry, evidence skip, parallel artifact join, and publish approval.
inputs: four 0.3.7 gate run IDs and their pinned commits
valid, missing, and corrupt per-file receipt records
incomplete batches, host lease failure, and rejected recovery
parallel artifact outcome and release commit
observations: the production receipt planner selects the uncovered or invalid receipt files for residual measurement
a repaired batch is audited again until every test file is covered
ledger-only defects pass only with complete same-commit evidence, zero introduced failures, and no other failures
receipt audit and artifact branches rendezvous through a deterministic start barrier
the join starts only after both branches end and artifact failure blocks publish approval
the old gate-same-run-recheck path is not used
